questions.text: A bakery records information about its daily orders, including the type of product purchased (bread, cake, pastry, etc.), the size of the cake (small, medium, large), the number of items sold per day, and the customer's order number. Which of the following statements are correct?
options: The type of product purchased is measured on the nominal scale.
The size of the cake is measured on the ordinal scale.
The number of items sold is measured on the interval scale.
The customer’s order number is measured on the ratio scale.
correct_answer: The type of product purchased is measured on the nominal scale.
The size of the cake is measured on the ordinal scale.
